title: Collections and Recovery Specialist at Volvo Financial Services (Vilnius or Riga)
description: Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. What you will do At Volvo Financial Services you will contribute to the transformation of our company, the transport industry and society at large. The Collections & Recovery Specialist plays an important role in supporting portfolio quality and minimizing credit losses across Lithuania, Latvia, and Estonia. The role combines analytical, operational and decision-support responsibilities by monitoring collections performance, preparing portfolio and overdue debt reporting, reviewing contract modification requests, and providing recommendations to support sound credit and collections decisions. The position reports to the Credit Manager at Volvo Financial Services Baltics. Main activities and core responsibilities: • Monitor collections and recovery performance across the Baltic portfolio. • Work with soft collections providers and directly with customers, as needed, to determine cause of delinquency and negotiate payment arrangements. • Prepare and maintain overdue debt (OVD), delinquency and collections performance reports for management. • Ensure data quality and consistency within collections and portfolio management reporting. • Analyze portfolio trends, identify risk areas and recommend corrective actions. • Review customer requests for contract modifications, payment extensions and restructurings. • Perform financial and risk assessment of modification requests and prepare recommendations for approval. • Initiate and handle termination of contracts due to default. • Coordinate Repossession and support Remarketing functions as required. • Support decision-making by providing portfolio, collections and recovery insights. • Monitor recovery performance and support actions aimed at maximizing recovered amounts. • Lead periodic collection meetings to discuss individual accounts and action items. • Drive continuous improvements in collections, recovery and contract administration processes. • Support implementation of new tools, products and business initiatives impacting collections activities. Who are you? In this role, you will bring: • University degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration or a related field. • Minimum 3 years of experience in collections, credit, risk management, accounts receivables or financial analysis. Experience in a customer service or similar environment is an advantage. • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. • Ability to assess financial risks and identify appropriate mitigation actions. • Good understanding of leasing and loan products. • High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities. • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. • Experience working in an international and multicultural environment is an advantage. • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel. • Fluency in Lithuanian or Latvian and advanced level of English. What’s in it for you? We offer a solid package of compensation and benefits, plus you will enjoy: • Joining a global and diverse team of highly skilled professionals who make customers win. • Opportunity to grow both personally and professionally. • Space to initiate and implement improvements that create value for customers and the business. • Environment where we work with passion, trust each other and embrace change to stay ahead. • Package of company benefits such as trainings, additional health insurance and more. title: Market Risk Analyst
description: We are seeking talented professionals to join our Risk Management team. The market risk team plays a central role in analysing, measuring, managing, and communicating the risks associated with the Asset and Origination portfolios, including related hedging strategies. The team is also responsible for independent analysis and for supporting the implementation of new contracts in our risk systems. Regularly report on the performance (P&L) and risks associated with our Asset and Origination portfolios, providing accurate and timely information to stakeholders. Monitor energy market developments, regulatory changes, and their potential impact on our portfolios. Perform comprehensive risk assessments of transactions and deal structures before execution, identifying key risks and proposing appropriate mitigation measures. Collaborate with internal stakeholders, including originators, portfolio managers, analysts, and credit risk teams, to ensure robust risk management and deal viability. Contribute to the continuous improvement of risk management processes and tools by sharing insights and proposing enhancements. We look for a Market Risk Analyst with the skills to future-proof our business and strengthen our market risk team. That includes: Advanced university degree in a quantitative discipline like Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Economics, Engineering or equivalent discipline. Knowledge of valuing and modelling derivatives is preferred. Programming experience (Preferably in Python). Strong attention to detail, integrity, and a proactive team player. Excellent communication skills with the ability to confidently engage with stakeholders. Fluent in English, both written and spoken. Knowledge of Norwegian is an advantage but not required This position is suitable for candidates with prior experience in energy markets or risk management, as well as talented graduates with an interest in renewable energy markets.

title: Plant Controller
description: Your contribution to something big Do you enjoy understanding what really drives performance in a manufacturing business, rather than simply reporting the numbers? As our Plant Controller, you will work at the intersection of finance and manufacturing , partnering closely with Plant Management and colleagues across production, logistics, engineering and other functions. You will turn financial and operational data into insights that support better decisions, stronger performance and continuous improvement. This is a hands-on controlling role where you can build a broad understanding of our manufacturing operation and have a real impact on how we manage costs, investments and performance. Your key responsibilities Business partnering: Act as a financial partner to Plant Management and cost center owners. Provide analysis, challenge assumptions and translate financial performance into clear insights and actions. Planning & forecasting: Drive key parts of our business planning, budgeting and forecasting processes, including cost centers, Capex, production volumes, headcount and product costs. Manufacturing performance: Analyze manufacturing costs, productivity and operational deviations. Work with the organization to understand root causes and identify appropriate countermeasures. Product costing: Lead Planned Product Cost (PPC) calculations, follow Actual Product Costs (APC) and analyze the operational and financial drivers behind deviations. Investments, assets & inventory: Support investment planning and follow-up, fixed asset management, inventory valuation, physical stocktaking and continuous inventory control. Reporting & continuous improvement: Drive monthly and annual plant performance reporting while continuously improving our processes, reporting, dashboards and use of SAP and other digital tools. What distinguishes you You have a degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Industrial Engineering and Management, or a comparable field, together with experience in controlling, financial analysis or a related finance role. Experience from manufacturing or another industrial environment is particularly valuable. We are looking for someone with: Strong analytical skills and confidence working with financial and operational data Experience with budgeting, forecasting, cost accounting or operational reporting Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel Experience working with ERP systems. SAP experience, particularly within controlling or manufacturing processes, is an advantage Professional working proficiency in English, both written and spoken. Swedish is an advantage, but not a requirement Experience with product costing, Power BI, automation or other data-analysis tools is an advantage, but you do not need to tick every box . We value your ability to learn, understand the business and turn data into meaningful insights. Who you are You are curious about the business behind the numbers . When you see a deviation, your instinct is not simply to report it. You want to understand why it happened, what is driving it and what we can do about it . You are comfortable asking questions, challenging assumptions and collaborating across functions to find solutions. You can explain financial concepts clearly to colleagues outside Finance and combine strong analytical thinking with a practical mindset. You take ownership of your work, build strong relationships and are motivated by understanding how a manufacturing business works and how Finance can help make it better.

title: PreMaster-Programm – Managementassistenz im FC-Bereich, Schwerpunkt Controlling (w/m/div.)
description: In dieser Position übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für die Überwachung der geschäftlichen und finanziellen Aspekte der von Ihrem Team vorgeschlagenen Kosteneinsparungsmaßnahmen. Durch Ihr Verständnis des finanziellen Hintergrunds dieser Veränderungen spielen Sie eine wichtige Rolle bei der Bewertung des Fortschritts dieser Maßnahmen. Dies erfolgt durch die Analyse der erwarteten Ergebnisse sowie des kommerziellen Status dieser Veränderungen. Bei diesen Aufgaben werden Sie von verschiedenen Teams weltweit unterstützt (Deutschland, Ungarn, Rumänien, USA, Indien und Mexiko). Sie stehen dabei nicht nur in engem Austausch mit Controlling-Teams, sondern auch mit den Bereichen Einkauf, Vertrieb und vielen weiteren Bosch-Einheiten weltweit. Gemeinsam stellen Sie entscheidungsrelevante Finanzinformationen bereit, die für Managemententscheidungen und die Projektsteuerung genutzt werden – insbesondere in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Controlling-Team bei der Erstellung der monatlichen Management-Reports. Ausbildung: Sie müssen ein Bachelorstudium in den Bereichen Statistik, Management, Informatik oder Wirtschaftswissenschaften erfolgreich abgeschlossen haben, dabei deutlich überdurchschnittliche Leistungen erzielt haben und fest beabsichtigen, anschließend ein Masterstudium aufzunehmen. Erfahrung und Kenntnisse: Sie verfügen idealerweise über einen Hintergrund in Datenanalyse sowie Planung & Forecasting. Projektmanagement-Erfahrung ist von Vorteil. Zudem bringen Sie sehr gute Kenntnisse in Excel, PowerPoint und Power BI mit. Qualifikationen: Sie sind gut organisiert, teamorientiert, kommunikativ und international ausgerichtet. Sprachen: Englisch auf C1-Niveau ist erforderlich, Deutsch auf B1-Niveau ist von Vorteil.

You will be supported in these tasks by various teams around the world (Germany, Hungary, Romania, USA, India and Mexico). You are not only in close contact with controlling teams, but also with purchasing, sales and many other Bosch units worldwide. Together, you will provide decision-relevant financial information that is used for management decisions and project control - especially in collaboration with the controlling team when preparing the monthly management reports. Education: You must have successfully completed a bachelor's degree in the fields of statistics, management, computer science or economics, have achieved significantly above-average performance and firmly intend to subsequently take up a master's degree. Experience and knowledge: Ideally, you have a background in data analysis and planning & forecasting. Project management experience is an advantage. You also have very good knowledge of Excel, PowerPoint and Power BI.

description: , United Kingdom Job Family Group: Trading Jobs Worker Type: Regular Posting Start Date: August 1, 2026 Business Unit: Experience Level: Experienced Professionals Job Description: What’s the role Shell Energy Europe & Environmental Products is seeking a Data Scientist to work within the Market Analysis team to develop and improve our forecasting models. Accurate forecasting of market fundamentals is critical to improved decision making on the trading desk. The analysis team develop and run a wide range of forecasts, using different methods such as machine learning, optimisation. What you’ll be doing Shell Energy Europe is looking to hire a data scientist to support the Power Fundamentals team in building and productionising time series forecasting and optimisation models (stochastic optimisation, dynamic programming, LP/MILP models, etc). This person will have an enthusiasm to learn the inner working of the power market by working in close collaboration with domain experts. They must be able to understand the fundamentals of the power market and translate this into a mathematical model. This requires taking a pragmatic approach to model development, starting with a simple model, and iteratively adding complexity – driven by adding business value in a high-pace environment. This person must be a strong programmer, who is confident in productionising models in the cloud (Azure/AWS) and is comfortable in designing and implementing data ingestion and model deployment pipelines. Responsibilities: Prepare, process, clean and visualize various kind of power, gas, and weather data sets to establish a basis of further analysis. Develop, analyse, and conduct different approaches to forecasts different variables (Demand, wind, solar, prices). Statistical evaluation and validation of different types of forecasts. Build the framework to deploy models in production that will be use every day for trading decisions. Share this framework with the rest of the team to increase the performance of the rest of the team developments. Participate to the conception and development of a computational environment which enable scalability and high computational power. title: Thesis Worker Evaluation of AI-enabled tools for Product Development Workflows
description: Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. Master’s Thesis Proposal This thesis is suitable for a student in mechanical engineering or product development, or a related discipline. The preferred start date is January 2027. Background Product development increasingly involves digital tools that support engineering workflows. AI-enabled tools may offer new ways to carry out tasks, access information and support collaboration. To understand their potential value, it is important to assess how well they support real product development needs, as well as their limitations and practical requirements. This thesis will compare two such tools for product development workflows. The work will be carried out at Engineering Method Development Dept. in Eskilstuna within Volvo CE. Project Summary The objective is to evaluate and compare the two tools in selected product development workflows. Together with Volvo engineers, the student will identify relevant use cases, define assessment criteria and conduct a structured evaluation of both tools. The study will consider their suitability for the selected workflows and develop recommendations for their potential use and further evaluation. Activities: Literature review on AI-enabled tools and their use in product development workflows. Identification and selection of relevant product development use cases. Definition of evaluation criteria, such as usability, workflow fit, output quality and practical limitations. Evaluation of each tool using the selected use cases. Analysis and comparison of the results. Development of recommendations and proposals for further work. Preparation of a technical report. Presentation at Eskilstuna site and the relevant university. Deliverables: Technical report. Comparative evaluation of the tools for the selected workflows. Recommendations for potential use and further evaluation. description: Ready to steer Bosch's performance? title: Junior Managers Program (Trainee) - Starte deine Leadership Journey im Bereich Controlling
description: Bereit, die Performance von Bosch zu steuern? title: Master Thesis on Adaptive Distributed Control of Grid-Forming Battery Energy Storage Systems
description: Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. Background The increasing penetration of Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) has accelerated the transition toward sustainable transportation and resilient electrical grids. Modern BESS installations are evolving into modular systems composed of multiple battery systems and multiple parallel Power Conversion Systems (PCSs). Current hierarchical control architectures enable coordinated operation, it also introduces communication dependency, latency and scalability challenges. This type of architecture relies on hierarchical communication between the Energy Management System (EMS), local BESS controllers and individual PCS controllers. Multiple communication layers may introduce delays, synchronization errors and reduced dynamic performance in the grid-forming operation. Communication failures or packet loss can degrade power sharing, frequency regulation and transient stability. Research Question The objective of this master thesis is to develop and validate an adaptive distributed control strategy for modular grid-forming Battery Energy Storage Systems comprising multiple parallel Power Conversion Systems (PCSs) and multiple Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESSs). The proposed solution should reduce communication dependency, improve dynamic performance during power dispatch, enhance robustness against communication failures and delays, and provide a scalable control architecture suitable for future large-scale energy storage systems. Objectives Reduce dependency on hierarchical communication. Improve dynamic response during power dispatch. Maintain accurate active/reactive power sharing. Improve scalability for future modular BESS installations. Develop and evaluate virtual impedance control to reduce circulating currents caused by voltage, phase, and impedance mismatches among parallel PCSs. Scope Of Work Conduct a literature review on grid-forming converters, Virtual Synchronous Generator (VSG) control, hierarchical and distributed control architectures for modular BESSs. Review the limitations of hierarchical communication, the motivation for adaptive control under varying operating conditions, and the applicability of Model Predictive Control (MPC) for predictive power sharing and constraint handling. [Weeks 1-4] Develop a hierarchical grid-forming control model for multiple parallel PCSs and BESSs, including communication-based power dispatch, power-sharing control, and virtual impedance control. This model will serve as the reference for performance comparison. [Weeks 5-12] Design and implement a distributed adaptive control strategy that reduces dependence on hierarchical communication while maintaining stable grid-forming operation, accurate active/reactive power sharing, and robust performance under communication delays and failures. If appropriate, investigate MPC to improve predictive power dispatch and constraint management. [Weeks 13-21] Validate the proposed control strategy in MATLAB/Simulink, PLECS and/or PSCAD under representative operating scenarios, including load variations, communication delays, communication failures, and grid disturbances. [Weeks 22-26] Compare the proposed distributed control with the baseline hierarchical controller using performance metrics including active/reactive power-sharing accuracy, frequency and voltage deviations, settling time, circulating current, communication bandwidth, and overall system robustness. [Week 27-29] Candidate Competencies Two MS students with the solid backgrounds in electrical engineering, with basic knowledge of power electronics, control systems, and power systems Experience with MATLAB/Simulink or similar simulation tools like PSCAD or DIgSILENT is desirable. Knowledge or previous experience in grid-connected converter control, BESS/PCS systems, adaptive or distributed control, and power-system stability is considered a merit. Ready for the next move? Are you excited to bring your skills and disruptive ideas to the table? We can’t wait to hear from you. Apply today! title: Jobstudent Data & Learning Analytics
description: Transport vormt de kern van onze moderne samenleving. Stel je voor dat je jouw expertise kan toepassen om duurzame transport- en infrastructureoplossingen voor de toekomst vorm te geven. Wil je een verschil maken op wereldwijde schaal en hierbij gebruik maken van de nieuwste technologieën en deel uitmaken van een sterk team? Dan zijn wij wellicht de perfecte match! Introductie Binnen ons Training Center investeren we dagelijks in de ontwikkeling en groei van onze medewerkers. Via ons Learning Management System (LMS) verzamelen we heel wat informatie over opleidingen, competenties, certificaten en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Maar data verzamelen is één ding. Er waardevolle informatie uit halen, is een volgende stap! Daarom zoeken we een enthousiaste jobstudent die graag met data werkt, analytisch denkt en het leuk vindt om informatie om te zetten naar overzichtelijke rapporten en dashboards. Je krijgt de kans om mee te bouwen aan een slimmer datagebruik binnen ons Training Center. Geen puur uitvoerende administratieve job, maar een opdracht waarin je zelf ideeën mag aanbrengen en mee nadenkt over hoe we onze processen kunnen verbeteren. Wat ga je doen? Je krijgt een aantal concrete uitdagingen voorgeschoteld: 1. Data verwerken en rapporteren • Data uit ons Learning Management System (LMS) verzamelen, analyseren en structureren. • Gegevens omzetten naar bruikbare rapporten voor officiële rapportering aan overheidsinstanties en de sector. • De kwaliteit en betrouwbaarheid van de gegevens controleren. • Rapporteringen efficiënter en overzichtelijker maken. 2. Certificaten en competenties opvolgen • Rapporten ontwikkelen om certificaten en opleidingen op te volgen. • Automatisch of via overzichtelijke rapporten inzichtelijk maken welke certificaten binnenkort vervallen. • Data gebruiken om de competentieontwikkeling en persoonlijke groei van medewerkers beter in kaart te brengen. 3. Dashboards bouwen • Overzichtelijke en gebruiksvriendelijke dashboards ontwikkelen. • Data visualiseren zodat informatie snel en eenvoudig geraadpleegd kan worden. • Meedenken over hoe we informatie beter toegankelijk kunnen maken voor medewerkers, leidinggevenden en het Training Center. 4. Meedenken en verbeteren • Zelf opportuniteiten ontdekken in onze bestaande data en rapporteringen. • Creatieve oplossingen bedenken om repetitieve taken te vereenvoudigen of te automatiseren. • Nieuwe ideeën voorstellen en samen met ons bekijken hoe we die kunnen realiseren. Wie ben jij? We zoeken geen student die enkel opdrachten uitvoert, maar iemand die graag zelf op ontdekking gaat en uitdagingen niet uit de weg gaat. Je herkent jezelf in volgende zaken: Je volgt een opleiding in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Toegepaste Informatica, Data Management of een vergelijkbare richting. Je hebt een goede kennis van Excel. Ervaring met Power BI is zeker een pluspunt. Je hebt interesse in data-analyse, rapportering en datavisualisatie. Je hebt bij voorkeur enige ervaring met de Microsoft-omgeving. Je werkt zelfstandig en neemt initiatief. Je bent analytisch ingesteld en hebt oog voor detail. Je bent creatief, denkt graag mee en durft bestaande werkwijzen in vraag te stellen. Je geeft niet op bij de eerste hindernis, maar zoekt naar oplossingen. Je bent 2 dagen/week beschikbaar om te werken. Wat zit er voor jou in? Een boeiende en concrete opdracht binnen een internationale bedrijfsomgeving. De mogelijkheid om jouw kennis van data-analyse en visualisatie in de praktijk toe te passen. Ruimte om zelfstandig te werken en eigen ideeën uit te proberen. Een directe bijdrage aan de verdere digitalisering en professionalisering van ons Training Center. Samenwerking met collega's die jouw inzichten en frisse blik waarderen. Interesse? Wil je jouw analytische vaardigheden inzetten om data om te zetten naar echte meerwaarde? Dan maken we graag kennis met jou! We hechten belang aan jouw privacy en daarom accepteren wij geen sollicitaties via mail. Wie we zijn en waar we in geloven We zijn toegewijd aan het vormgeven van de toekomstige landschap van efficiënte, veilige en duurzame transportoplossingen. Het vervullen van onze missie creëert ontelbare carrièremogelijkheden voor talenten binnen de toonaangevende merken en entiteiten van de groep. Solliciteren op deze functie biedt je de kans om je bij de Volvo Group aan te sluiten. Elke dag werk je samen met enkele van de scherpste en meest creatieve geesten in ons vakgebied om onze samenleving in een betere staat achter

description: Transport vormt de kern van onze moderne samenleving. Stel je voor dat je jouw expertise kan toepassen om duurzame transport- en infrastructureoplossingen voor de toekomst vorm te geven. Heeft een sterke interesse in hard HR (data, beloning, beleid, compliance) Kan goed overweg met Microsoft office, andere tools zijn een pluspunt Zoekt een stage van minimum 2 maand (bij voorkeur langer) Werkt nauwkeurig, is gemotiveerd en neemt graag ownership over een deelproject Klaar voor jouw nieuwe uitdaging? Neem dan ownership over een concrete stageopdracht binnen Compensation & Benefits en maak mee het verschil voor onze medewerkers. Dan leren we je graag kennen. Tot snel! We hechten belang aan jouw privacy en daarom accepteren wij geen sollicitaties via mail. Wie we zijn en waar we in geloven We zijn toegewijd aan het vormgeven van de toekomstige landschap van efficiënte, veilige en duurzame transportoplossingen. Het vervullen van onze missie creëert ontelbare carrièremogelijkheden voor talenten binnen de toonaangevende merken en entiteiten van de groep. Solliciteren op deze functie biedt je de kans om je bij de Volvo Group aan te sluiten. Gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Strategy Managern übernimmst du die Steuerung strategischer Projekte und leitest einzelne Workstreams innerhalb dieser Initiativen. Durch die Analyse von Entwicklungen im Offshore-Wind-Sektor und den übergeordneten Energiemärkten lieferst du wertvolle Erkenntnisse für strategische und geschäftliche Entscheidungen. Dabei identifizierst du Chancen, Risiken und mögliche Handlungsfelder. Gleichzeitig arbeitest du gerne im Team und überzeugst durch Integrität und Verlässlichkeit. Verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie die Fähigkeit, sicher in einem internationalen Geschäftsumfeld zu agieren. title: Bachelor thesis A Financial Framework for Prioritizing Online Condition Monitoring Implementation
description: Help Shape the Future of Smart Maintenance. As manufacturing becomes increasingly data-driven, organizations are looking for smarter ways to improve equipment reliability, reduce maintenance costs, and maximize production availability. Online condition monitoring is a key enabler of this transformation, helping businesses move from reactive maintenance toward predictive and proactive strategies. We are now looking for two Bachelor students who want to explore how economic and operational data can be used to make better investment decisions regarding condition monitoring technologies. Thesis Scope The aim of this thesis is to investigate how online condition monitoring systems can be prioritized and implemented from an economic perspective. The project will focus on developing a decision support tool that helps identify where condition monitoring can create the greatest business value. The thesis is expected to: Develop a framework for evaluating condition monitoring opportunities across manufacturing equipment Assess machine criticality, maintenance costs, production availability, and Remaining Useful Life (RUL) Combine technical and business-related data into a structured decision support tool Identify where condition monitoring solutions can generate the highest value Recommend approaches for improving maintenance planning, reducing costs, and increasing operational availability This project offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of engineering, maintenance, operations, and business economics while contributing to the future of smart manufacturing. Who We Believe You Are You are currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree within: Production Engineering Mechanical Engineering Industrial Economics Or a related field You have an interest in manufacturing, maintenance, data analysis, and continuous improvement. You enjoy solving complex problems and can combine analytical thinking with a practical business perspective. What You'll Gain Hands-on experience within a leading global manufacturing organization Exposure to predictive maintenance and condition monitoring technologies Opportunities to work with both technical and business stakeholders Insights into how data-driven decision-making supports operational excellence Valuable experience in developing practical tools that can support real business decisions Practical Information Thesis Level: Bachelor's Thesis Number of Students: 2 Location: Volvo Group Language: Swedish or English Semester: Spring 2027 Application Deadline: November 30, 2026 We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail. Who we are and what we believe in We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities. Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group . Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. ​We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. ​We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment. Trucks Technology & Industrial Division hire team players who are ready to create real customer impact. Our decentralized teams work close to our customers, with speed and autonomy, to build what they truly need. Join us to collaborate on innovative, sustainable technologies that redefine how we design, build, and deliver value. Bring your curiosity, your expertise, and your collaborative energy, and together, we’ll turn bold ideas into tangible solutions for our customers and contribute to a more sustainable tomorrow.

title: Developer & Business Analyst – PnL & Risk Systems
description: This role is ideal for a passionate, entrepreneurially minded developer who thrives on ownership , impact , and a dynamic environment. You will have end-to-end ownership of the solutions you deliver, from the first conversation with the business to final rollout and beyond. You will be trusted to shape the best approach to delivering against business priorities and timelines, in a flat, team-oriented environment that values ideas and individual contributions. Your role We have developed our own Commodity Trading Risk Management (CTRM) system that covers all aspects of our business activities across the globe: from trade entry through middle-office, with P&L reporting and price risk management, down to invoicing – for every commodity we trade, including electricity, renewables, gas, crude oil, refined products, biofuels, or carbon certificates. We place our CTRM at the heart of how the company operates; it is used daily by teams across trading, middle office, finance and operations. Our most critical systems are built in-house by teams like ours, helping orchestrate global energy flows. What defines success in this role: Technical excellence : design and implement clean, well-documented and extensible features. Write maintainable, high-performance code. Ownership: work with a high degree of autonomy and take responsibility for the full lifecycle of your deliverables: requirements, design, development, testing, rollout, training and ongoing support. Business partnership : engage directly with trading desks, finance and senior management to identify and prioritise requirements. There is no intermediary: you are both the business analyst and the developer. You go beyond what users explicitly ask for: understanding the context, spotting pain points they may not articulate directly, and building what truly serves the business. Teamwork : end-to-end ownership does not mean working alone. Your work integrates into a much larger system, and you stay closely connected with other development teams. You will become a trusted partner to colleagues and stakeholders across the firm. As we work as one united team covering PnL, Risk, VAR and options, the projects may be as diverse as: Helping redesign our CTRM reporting architecture to enable fast, scalable access for the demands of an AI-driven world Modelling cash-for-product loan repayments in our Finance P&L Building a valuation engine for complex options that we trade Running a systems integration with a company we have acquired For large projects, you may travel to other Vitol main offices – Houston, Singapore, London, Rotterdam – to ensure smooth integration and adoption on the ground. Our technology Our core technologies, PL/SQL and Oracle Forms Builder, form the foundation of our core trading platform and have been central to Vitol's success story. When you join, you will work with these established technologies to quickly get up to speed with our data model and business logic, and start adding value from day one. As our platform continues to evolve, we are progressively embracing a more contemporary technology stack, creating opportunities for those interested to be part of shaping what comes next. Required University degree in Computer Science, Financial Engineering, or an equivalent field At least 3 years' experience as a software engineer, ideally in a role combining technical and functional responsibilities Proven data modelling skills to translate business situations into data structures Proficiency in SQL Team player with strong entrepreneurial drive and ability to work independently Proactive and user-focused "make it work" mentality with a genuine interest in both the functional and technical aspects of each challenge Comfortable with a daily release cycle and a fast-paced, results-oriented environment Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, comfortable engaging with non-technical and senior stakeholders Full professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken Nice to have Experience with PL/SQL (preferred) or a similar procedural DB programming language (e.g. T-SQL) Practical experience with Oracle Forms builder Previous experience in the commodities and/or trading industry Familiarity with PnL, accounting, or risk concepts French is a plus

title: Senior HR Controller d/w/m Corporate Controlling, MSF & HR Controlling
description: RWE Offshore Wind GmbH Start zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt, Vollzeit / Teilzeit, unbefristet Als Senior HR Controller (d/f/m) bist du Teil des Teams Management Support Functions & HR Controlling in dem schnell wachsenden Offshore Wind Business. Das Team ist verantwortlich für das HR Controlling, insbesondere für die Personalplanung und das Reporting für die gesamte Offshore Organisation. Darüber hinaus trägt das Team dazu bei, dass die Offshore Wind Management Support Funktionen ihre finanziellen Ziele in einem internationalen Geschäftsumfeld erreichen. Die Rolle Du fungierst als HR Controlling Business Partner:in für das Senior Management (Direktor:innen) In Zusammenarbeit mit HR koordinierst, realisierst und optimierst du die HR-Mittelfristplanungs- und Forecasting-Prozesse global über Teams, Rechtseinheiten und Länder hinweg. Du entwickelst auch den Prozess zur Konsolidierung der Daten weiter Zudem prüfst, bewertest, kommentierst und hinterfragst du die von den jeweiligen Abteilungen bereitgestellten Planungsdaten für den Mittelfristplanungs-, Forecasting- und Budgetierungsprozess Du überwachst sowie analysierst die Personalkostenentwicklung. Darüber hinaus schaffst du Transparenz über die tatsächliche Kostenentwicklung im Vergleich zum Budget, zu mittel- bis langfristigen Finanzzielen und Benchmarks, z. B. über den Stellenplan Die eigenständige Erstellung von qualitativ hochwertigen Managementberichten, Präsentationen und Ad-hoc-Analysen für das Senior Management gehört ebenfalls zu deinen Aufgaben. Dies umfasst auch die Präsentation der wichtigsten Ergebnisse auf Top-Management-Ebene Du verantwortest die Aufrechterhaltung und Weiterentwicklung des Kostencontrollings, eines umfassenden Rahmens für Gewinn- und Kostenstellen und einer erhöhten Genauigkeit der Kostenzuweisungen Du konsolidierst die Personaldaten sowie -kommentare für vierteljährliche Ist-Berichte, Prognosen und Planungen Eine weitere vielfältige Aufgabe ist die weitere Verbesserung der Qualität und Digitalisierung des HR Management Reporting & Tools, der Controlling Prozesse sowie der IT-Landschaft Du übernimmst Verantwortung in Sonderprojekten wie IT-Optimierungen, Reorganisationen oder strategischen Planungen, indem du deine HR-Controlling-Expertise einbringst. Generell verstehst du dich in deinem Job als Schnittstelle zu verschiedenen Stakeholdern in Human Resources, Controlling und Business Funktionen zu unterschiedlichen HR Controlling Themen Dein Profil Du hast dein Hochschulstudium der Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs, idealerweise mit den Schwerpunkten Controlling, HR oder Finanzen mit sehr guten Ergebnissen abgeschlossen Darüber hinaus punktest du mit mehrjähriger relevanter Berufserfahrung und nachweisbaren Erfolgen im Controlling - vorzugsweise im HR-Controlling - in HR-relevanten Bereichen wie z.B. Stelleneinstufung und -vergütung, Rekrutierung, Auswahl, Weiterbildung, Sozialleistungen und Chancengleichheit sowie im Finanzbereich Dein umfassendes betriebswirtschaftliches Wissen erstreckt sich auf die Energiewirtschaft und die IT. In diesem Zusammenhang besteht bei dir ein klarer Wunsch, dein Wissen zu erweitern Der Einsatz deiner sehr guten Microsoft-Office-Fähigkeiten (insb. Excel und PowerPoint) und fortgeschrittenen Kenntnisse im Umgang mit SAP (HR- und CO-Modul, SAP BW) sowie Informationsmanagementsystemen sind für dich im beruflichen Alltag selbstverständlich Du beherrschst HRIS, die Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnung und ähnliche Personalverwaltungssoftware oder bist in der Lage, dich schnell darin einzuarbeiten Deine Teamfähigkeit kann als ausgezeichnet bezeichnet werden. Du arbeitest gerne in einem motivierenden Teamumfeld Wir können uns auf deine sehr guten numerischen und analytischen Fähigkeiten verlassen. Du besitzt die Fähigkeit, umfangreiche Daten und Informationen strukturiert zu interpretieren und zu kommunizieren sowie auch komplexe Transaktionen und kommerzielle Fragen zu bearbeiten Zudem überzeugst du uns mit deiner hohen persönliche Glaubwürdigkeit und deiner Fähigkeit, in einem internationalen Umfeld vertrauensvoll und effektiv mit Interessengruppen auf allen Ebenen zu interagieren. description_en: The role You act as an HR controlling business partner for senior management (directors). In collaboration with HR, you coordinate, implement and optimize the HR medium-term planning and forecasting processes globally across teams, legal entities and countries. You also further develop the process for consolidating the data. You also check, evaluate, comment on and question the planning data provided by the respective departments for the medium-term planning, forecasting and budgeting process. You monitor and analyze the development of personnel costs. In addition, you create transparency about the actual cost development compared to the budget, medium to long-term financial goals and benchmarks, e.g. B. via the position plan The independent creation of high-quality management reports, presentations and ad hoc analyzes for senior management is also part of your tasks. This also includes the presentation of the most important results at top management level You are responsible for maintaining and further developing cost controlling, a comprehensive framework for profit and cost centers and increased accuracy of cost allocations You consolidate the personnel data and comments for quarterly actual reports, forecasts and planning Another diverse task is the further improvement of the quality and digitalization of the HR management reporting & tools, the controlling processes and the IT landscape You take responsibility in special projects such as IT optimizations, reorganizations or strategic planning by bringing in your HR controlling expertise. In general, in your job you see yourself as an interface to various stakeholders in human resources, controlling and business functions on different HR controlling topics

Translate complex market fundamentals, exposures, and trading opportunities into clear and actionable insights. Analyse market trends, supply-demand dynamics, generation, weather, transmission constraints, interconnectors, and other key drivers of power prices. Substantial experience and proven track record in fundamental analysis and modelling of the European Power markets, ideally across more than one trading house. In-depth knowledge of the German, French and UK power markets and the drivers that link them Knowledge of cross-border power flows, interconnectors, transmission constraints, and capacity markets. Strong understanding of how traders identify opportunities, construct positions, and generate profit. Ability to take the models, data and tools we already have, build on them and improve them, rather than recreate what you have done elsewhere. A creative and curious approach, open to new methods and not tied to one way of doing things. Confidence to advise the Head of the Continental Power Trading desk on strategy, turning analysis into clear recommendations rather than just producing data. Demonstrated ability to independently deliver analytical projects from concept through implementation. A clear preference for analytics over trading, and motivation to build long-term analytical capability. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage in effective and direct communication at all levels. Strong analytical, problem-solving, with exceptional attention to detail. Proficiency in Python.

We truly care about the customer’s business in terms of up-time, safety, productivity and of course 100% green energy supply. The energy transition will not come for free – but we are committed to support this transition by hard and dedicated work. So - what are we looking for in this specific role? Volvo Energy is providing a highly qualified digital platform, an Energy Management System (EMS), to control our Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS). We are now looking for Senior OT Network & Systems Engineer that will support in establishing cyber secure connectivity towards BESS units and the BESS digital twin using the appointed Volvo Energy Site Controller. As the energy space rely on standards for interoperability between energy systems, like Modbus, IEC 60870-5, 61850 and DNP-3, you make sure that the IoT Edge solution is designed according to cyber security standards. You also ensure cyber secure connectivity to the Volvo Energy EMS solution via MQTT/OPC-UA as defined by the Volvo Energy target architecture. You will work closely together with several different qualified teams to help design and build the solution and report functionally to the Volvo Energy Head of Enterprise architecture. You’ll design secure, scalable network environments—everything from segmentation and VLAN structures to DMZ zones and redundancy strategies—both for our own products and for customer sites. As the technical owner of our OT networking landscape, you’ll create and maintain clear, high‑quality diagrams and documentation that bring structure to complex systems and ensure smooth integration with cloud platforms and external SCADA/EMS solutions. A big part of your work will center around cybersecurity. You’ll define modern firewall rulesets built on IEC 62443 and zero‑trust principles, validate safe communication paths for industrial protocols like Modbus, and take full responsibility for the lifecycle of our OT firewalls. That includes firmware updates, patching strategies, redundancy testing, vendor coordination, and the automated deployment of configurations across our global BESS fleet using FortiManager. You’ll also play a hands-on role in our production environments—diving into troubleshooting, leading root‑cause analysis, and contributing to cybersecurity assessments and audits that strengthen our defenses. Collaboration will be at the heart of your everyday work. You’ll partner with engineering teams at our assembly plants to ensure firewalls are configured correctly from the moment a unit is built, and you’ll work with Digital/IT teams to define secure, future‑proof IT–OT demarcation points. Along the way, you’ll also share your expertise with junior engineers and project teams, helping them grow while raising the overall technical bar. title: Senior Commercial Contract Manager
description: The Contract Management department within the Project Delivery and Engineering function of BU Offshore Wind at Vattenfall, is responsible for overseeing contract execution of all our major CAPEX supply agreements for our offshore wind projects. The department has a close collaboration with our procurement functions to support contract drafting and negotiations during tendering processes, and thereafter to take contract ownership. In addition, the department has responsibility for claims management. Your responsibilities Proactive management of contracts to ensure a full alignment of the project team to meet the given contractual obligations of both parties as well as on the commercial alignment of work progress with the defined project budget. Ability to draft contracts, lead negotiations and participate in tender processes for major CAPEX supply agreement in alignment with package managers and procurement function. Leads the contractual handling of variation requests and/or notices from contractors in close collaboration with the package manager, CPDM, procurement and legal. Ensures that contractual variations and changes or claims with regard to the scope of delivery and services, prices, timeline or other contractual agreements are enforced and up-to-date. Monitors and reports contract performance to the project and package MT. In cooperation with the Package Manager, drafts claim related correspondence, e.g. instructions, determinations, notices, variation orders and employer’s claims. Supports with early and holistic preparation and documentation of dispute readiness documentation. Supports the procurement manager, package manager, technical and commercial project manager and project director with the contractual arrangements, management and award of contracts. Responsible for the monitoring and reporting of package budget, including adjustments to the contract values during execution. Your profile Extensive experience with offshore wind transmission scope, including export cable systems, offshore and onshore substations, grid connection works and the key technical and contractual interfaces between these packages. Substantial experience in complex commercial roles and major CAPEX project tendering and execution. Proven offshore wind experience, preferably from the development, construction and execution phases of large-scale projects. Demonstrated ability to independently manage a transmission-related contract or package from tender and contract award through execution, handover and close-out. Self-driven and proactive, with the ability to establish priorities, identify commercial and contractual risks early, and progress matters with limited supervision while maintaining alignment with the wider project team. knowledge of FIDIC and LOGIC contracts, legal and commercial contract terms, and their practical application to offshore wind transmission packages. Strong commercial contract and negotiation skills, including experience with variations, notices, claims, delay, programme impacts and disputes. Proven ability to translate technical, programme and interface issues into clear contractual and commercial positions, supporting effective risk management and decision-making. Solid understanding of construction terminology, progress calculation methods, programmes of work, project timelines and critical path analysis. Strong analytical skills and the ability to consolidate complex information and present clear, structured recommendations to project and senior management. Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills in English, combined with strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build constructive working relationships with internal stakeholders and contractors. Education Graduate degree in a commercial subject, law, engineering or equivalent with relevant commercial work experience in large scale project execution

title: Business Controller
description: Do you enjoy driving business performance from a central finance position? Are you an experienced finance professional who can turn complex financial data into strategic insights? Do you thrive in a role where you oversee the bigger picture, steer reporting processes, and support senior management with decision-making? We are looking for a Business Controller to join the Business Control team within Vattenfall's rapidly growing E-Mobility Business Unit. In this central controlling role, you will be responsible for providing insights into the overall financial performance of the Business Unit. You will act as a key partner to senior management, ensuring high-quality financial reporting, forecasting, planning, and performance steering across multiple countries and business areas. Working closely with Business Control colleagues, Finance teams, and senior stakeholders, you will help translate financial results into actionable insights that support the continued growth and development of Vattenfall's E-Mobility business. What will you do? As Senior Business Controller, you will play a key role in steering the overall financial performance of the E-Mobility Business Unit and ensuring a reliable and efficient reporting framework. You will: Coordinate and steer the monthly performance reporting cycle for the overall Business Unit. Consolidate financial results across countries, functions, and business areas into clear management reporting. Deliver insights and analyses on business performance, key value drivers, risks, and opportunities. Lead forecasting activities and translate business developments into reliable financial outlooks. Drive the annual budget and business planning process for the Business Unit. Support senior management with strategic analyses, business cases, and decision-making. Further develop and improve reporting standards, controlling processes, and governance frameworks. Ensure consistency, accuracy, and transparency in financial reporting and performance measurement. Collaborate closely with Business Controllers, Accounting, and Finance teams across different countries. Identify opportunities to automate and enhance reporting tools, KPIs, and management information. Contribute to cross-functional improvement initiatives that support the continued growth of E-Mobility. You will report to the Director of Business Control E-Mobility and work closely with stakeholders across multiple countries and disciplines. Who are you? You are able to combine strong analytical capabilities with a strategic mindset and enjoy understanding how financial performance connects to broader business objectives. You are comfortable working with large amounts of data, creating structure in complex environments, and translating financial outcomes into meaningful insights for senior stakeholders. You can switch effortlessly between detailed financial analysis and high-level performance discussions. With a proactive and collaborative approach, you build strong relationships across the organisation and contribute to continuous improvement. We believe you bring: At least 7 years of experience in Business Controlling, Financial Controlling, FP&A, Corporate Finance, or a similar finance-related role. A master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field. Experience with consolidated reporting, forecasting, and business planning in a complex international organisation. Strong analytical and financial modelling skills. Experience working with senior stakeholders and management teams. The ability to translate complex financial information into clear and actionable recommendations. Advanced Excel and presentation skills; experience with SAP and reporting tools is highly valued. Full professional proficiency in English. Experience within the utilities, energy, infrastructure, or other asset-intensive industries is considered an advantage. Location: Berlin, Stockholm or Amsterdam

If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. We also scan the horizon for future portfolio business opportunities, assessing their strategic fit and potential to help guide what comes next. By combining this strategic mindset with Volvo CE's overall portfolio planning, you will help strengthen our future offering and keep us competitive as a company. Positioned at the center of our main stakeholders, including technology, regions, finance, and strategic leaders, you will manage these relationships to build alignment. Communicating this data-driven approach, you will keep business and customer needs at the forefront of the conversation. This will help us balance our experienced ways of working in portfolio management with greater reliance on data, a process that brings valuable learnings in change leadership. You will also translate these needs into concrete content and priorities. Who are you? We are looking for someone with a strong transformation and collaborative mindset who is eager to learn, explore and understand the business. You thrive in dynamic environments, embrace new challenges and ambiguity and take ownership of your own development and growth. With strong analytical skills, you take initiatives and drive tasks forward with determination while bringing fresh perspectives and innovative ideas to the team. In addition, you contribute to a culture of continuous learning by actively sharing knowledge, exchanging insights and supporting the development of others. description: Shape the future of HR and Business with us! We are looking for master’s graduates with entrepreneurial thinking and a drive to make a difference, who want to take on responsibility and prepare for a career in HR or commercial management in our Junior Managers Program. Depending on your profile and development goals, you will gain insights into areas such as HR Strategy, Digitalization, HR Business Partnering, Talent Management, and Organizational Development, as well as Controlling, Finance, or Business Development. Your mission: connect business-driven decisions with a strong people perspective.​ You won't just support—you will shape, decide, and take on responsibility. You will bring in your own ideas and experience firsthand how financial steering, transformation, and effective HR work interact. This way, you will develop a broad understanding of our business and purposefully prepare for your future career in commercial or HR management.​ What you will learn and develop with us:​ You will learn how a global technology company is steered and how people strategy, finance, markets, processes, and organization collectively contribute to business success. You will actively shape strategic and operational projects, for example in the areas of restructuring and M&A, employer branding, performance management, or digitalization. You will take ownership of your own work packages or projects, prepare executive management decisions, and implement sustainable improvements together with international and local teams. You will develop your personal career profile through deliberately combined HR and business rotations, regular feedback, and guidance from your personal executive-level mentor. Your academic foundation:​ You have graduated with an outstanding full-time Master's degree, e.g., in Business Administration, Economics, Industrial Engineering, Business Informatics, Human Resources Management, Business Psychology, or a related field of study. Ideally, you combine a commercial focus with a strong interest in people and organizational topics. Perhaps you already bring an MBA, a PhD, or initial relevant work experience.​ Qualifications Your passion for Business & People:​ You do not want to look at commercial relationships in isolation, but want to understand how strategy, organization, and people create impact together. Initial practical experience in at least one of the fields of HR, Controlling, Finance, Purchasing, Sales, Strategy, or Business Development is required.​ Your eye for the bigger picture:​ You think entrepreneurially, recognize connections across functional boundaries, and can derive clear options for action from data, market requirements, and employee perspectives. Your understanding of human-centric leadership:​ You can inspire people, approach others openly, and build trusting relationships. You are convinced that sustainable performance is created through clear goals, collaboration, and the development of people.​ You think strategically and shape the future:​ You challenge existing processes, develop sustainable solutions, and drive topics forward from analysis to implementation. You view digitalization, transformation, and new business models as opportunities that you want to actively help shape.​ Your career ambition:​ You want to take on responsibility and develop into a leader over the long term. You are open to various career paths, for example in HR Management, in an HR Business Partner role, in Controlling, in Strategy, or in another commercial function.​ Your continuous development:​ You are curious, learn quickly, and actively use new tasks, perspectives, and feedback for your personal growth. Moving between HR and business contexts motivates you and consciously broadens your profile.​ Your language proficiency: You communicate fluently in English (negotiation level) and ideally possess good German language skills. description: Du möchtest nicht nur Zahlen verwalten, sondern aktiv die finanzielle Zukunft eines führenden Maschinenbauunternehmens mitgestalten? Bei uns tauchst du tief in die Welt der Unternehmenssteuerung ein und leistest einen direkten Beitrag zu unserem Erfolg. Während deines Praktikums unterstützt du bei der übergreifenden Steuerung unseres gesamten Projektportfolios, von der initialen Wirtschaftlichkeitsrechnung über die laufende Budgetverfolgung bis zur finalen Nachkalkulation. Du arbeitest aktiv bei der jährlichen Unternehmens- und Budgetplanung mit und unterstützt unser Team bei der Erstellung des monatlichen Berichtswesens für die Geschäftsführung. Darüber hinaus wirkst du bei der jährlichen Kalkulation und Analyse unserer internen Verrechnungs- und Stundensätze für Engineering, Montage und Service mit, prüfst Daten auf Plausibilität und visualisierst deine Ergebnisse prägnant. An der Kostenstellen-, Kostenträger- und Profit-Center-Rechnung beteiligst du dich aktiv und trägst dazu bei, die Kostentransparenz im gesamten Unternehmen sicherzustellen. Nicht zuletzt bringst du deine Ideen bei der Analyse und Weiterentwicklung unserer Controlling-Instrumente und -Prozesse ein und arbeitest an abteilungsübergreifenden Sonderthemen mit. Ausbildung: Studium im wirtschaftswissenschaftlichen Bereich wie BWL, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder vergleichbar mit Schwerpunkt Controlling, Finanzen oder Unternehmensrechnung Erfahrungen und Know-how: sicherer Umgang mit Datenbanken und Excel, auch bei großen Datenmengen; erste theoretische oder praktische Kenntnisse in SAP von Vorteil Persönlichkeit und Arbeitsweise: dir gelingt es, eigenverantwortlich, proaktiv und detailgenau zu arbeiten, wobei du unternehmensweite Zusammenhänge schnell erfasst und analytisch denkst Arbeitsalltag: deine Präsenz vor Ort ist erforderlich Sprachen: verhandlungssicheres Deutsch
description_en: Do you not just want to manage numbers, but also want to actively shape the financial future of a leading mechanical engineering company? With us, you will immerse yourself deeply in the world of corporate management and make a direct contribution to our success. During your internship, you will support the comprehensive management of our entire project portfolio, from the initial profitability calculation to ongoing budget tracking to the final post-calculation. You will actively participate in annual corporate and budget planning and support our team in preparing monthly reports for management. In addition, you will be involved in the annual calculation and analysis of our internal billing and hourly rates for engineering, assembly and service, check data for plausibility and visualize your results concisely. Last but not least, you will contribute your ideas to the analysis and further development of our controlling instruments and processes and work on cross-departmental special topics. Education: Studies in the field of economics such as business administration, industrial engineering, business informatics or comparable with a focus on controlling, finance or corporate accounting Experience and know-how: confident use of databases and Excel, even with large amounts of data; Initial theoretical or practical knowledge of SAP is an advantage Personality and way of working: you are able to work independently, proactively and with attention to detail, whereby you quickly grasp company-wide connections and think analytically. Day-to-day work: your presence on site is required. Languages: business-fluent German

title: Commercial Manager (18-month temporary position)
description: As part of BA Wind you will play a key role in one of the most exciting pipelines in the industry with 24GW of capacity stretching out more than a decade ahead across our key European markets. You won’t only be involved in developing projects but pioneering cutting-edge innovation, new business models and ways of working with communities and the environment. Working as part of a leading European utility also means you could be helping a growing number of major businesses and brands achieve their own sustainability goals through partnerships. We are looking for a Commercial Manager to join our Commercial Operations team on a temporary full-time basis for 18 months . In this role, you will have end-to-end commercial responsibility for assigned offshore wind assets in Germany. Acting as the key commercial partner to Site Management, you will manage a broad range of operational contracts, drive commercial performance, and ensure contractual risks and opportunities are effectively managed. Working closely with Operations, Procurement, Finance, Legal, Asset Management, and external suppliers, you will help create commercial value, support efficient operations, and contribute to continuous improvement across the assets. What will you do? Commercial Management Partner with Site Management on commercial, contractual, and financial matters. Provide commercial analysis and recommendations to support operational and strategic decisions. Identify and manage commercial risks and opportunities. Support budgeting, forecasting, and performance reviews. Lead or support commercial negotiations and contract-related discussions. Contract Management Manage operational contracts throughout their lifecycle. Monitor supplier performance and compliance with contractual obligations. Handle contract variations, claims, and commercial disputes where required. Maintain strong relationships with suppliers and key internal stakeholders. Continuous Improvement Drive improvements to commercial processes, reporting, and ways of working. Identify and implement value-creation and cost-saving opportunities. Promote best practices and share lessons learned across assets and functions. Who are you? You are a commercially driven professional with experience in contract and supplier management within a complex operational environment. You combine strong analytical skills with a pragmatic mindset and are comfortable working with both commercial details and broader business objectives. You build strong relationships, communicate confidently with stakeholders at all levels, and take ownership of delivering results. Structured and proactive by nature, you thrive in a dynamic environment where priorities can shift and no two days are the same. Next to this you bring: A degree in a commercial, legal, engineering or similar discipline Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in contract, commercial or procurement roles — preferably in renewables, energy, oil & gas, or other complex industries Experience interpreting, managing, supporting and negotiating commercial agreements supported by a strong commercial mindset Experience with operational renewable energy assets Ability to manage many tasks simultaneously with structure and prioritization Experience working with suppliers and external stakeholders Must be able to manage and negotiate contracts in English German language is a plus, not a must Location: Amsterdam (Netherlands), Kolding or Copenhagen (Denmark), Hamburg (Germany) or London (UK)

We strive to create a positive and impactful work environment. Transformation brings new possibilities and fosters our courage and curiosity. Maintaining and developing the global service delivery model and fostering strong partnerships with key stakeholders and counterparties. title: Head of Credit Risk Management
description: Where balancing risk and business value drives performance there's a way. Join us as our Head of Credit Risk Management Credit Risk is an international team of experts working in the Amsterdam, Hamburg, Berlin and Stockholm offices. The teams role is to analyse counterparty creditworthiness, decide credit limits within applicable mandates, provide recommendations to business and management on credit-related matters, support the business in contract negotiations, monitor adherence to applicable credit risk policies, instructions and limits and provide transparency on credit risk exposures within the Vattenfall Group. Credit Risk continuously streamlines and adjusts its processes to adapt to new way of working whilst continuing to provide sound credit risk analysis, recommendations and decisions. As our Head of Credit Risk Management you will: Lead an international team of credit analysts covering all Business Areas / Staff Functions and processes (financing, investments, procurement, sales and trading) in all Vattenfall markets, Make credit decisions and prepare credit recommendations for decision makers in the business and on Group-level, including the Vattenfall Risk Committee (VRC) and Executive Group Management (EGM), Collaborate with Business Areas and Staff Functions to deliver tailored, demand-driven credit risk management services, Develop, implement and maintain Vattenfall’s credit risk management framework, Provide transparent and relevant credit risk reporting to various stakeholders including Business Area / Staff Function management, VRC, EGM and Audit Committee / Board, As a member of the Group Risk Management MT, actively contribute to the development of the overall Risk Management framework within Vattenfall, Continuously drive operational excellence by streamlining processes and developing new ways of working leveraging available systems, tools and digital solutions, Location : Hamburg, Amsterdam or Stockholm. You are a trusted leader who creates clarity, encourages different perspectives and enables experienced professionals to perform at their best. You combine independent judgement and integrity with a pragmatic and solution-oriented approach and are comfortable balancing a strong approach to risk governance with the needs of the business. You have experience leading teams or functions through change management processes such as the introduction of new tools, processes or ways of working. You effectively build engagement around change and help shift mindsets towards a proactive, collaborative and business-supporting approach while maintaining strict independence according to governance requirements. You act as a role model for Vattenfall's LEAD leadership expectations: Lead Yourself, Enable People, Align Teams, and Drive Performance. Next to this we expect you to bring: Knowledge of financial statement analysis, supported by a relevant academic background Experience of credit risk management (for example credit analysis, rating methodologies, credit systems or credit risk mitigation and structuring), Understanding of the commodity and energy markets (physical and financial), Relevant leadership experience in an international or complex organisational environment, Experience driving digitalisation, continuous improvement or transformation, Strong stakeholder-management skills and the ability to build constructive relationships across business and functional boundaries, The ability to communicate complex matters clearly and provide concise, well-founded recommendations to senior decision-makers, Professional fluency in English; German, Swedish or Dutch is an advantage. Experience from other relevant Vattenfall Businesses and understanding of stakeholder needs in our core markets is welcome.

title: Manager Tax Reporting, Risk Management & Technology ContiTech (m/f/diverse) - REF92635Y
description: We are looking for a Tax Manager – Tax Reporting, Risk Management & Technology to join our global tax team. In this role, you will ensure accurate and timely tax reporting across budget, forecast, and actuals, while developing and implementing a robust tax risk management framework for the ContiTech Group. You will act as a key contact for German and international entities, proactively identifying tax risks and supporting operational tax functions. This position offers a unique opportunity to work independently in a small global team with a broad range of responsibilities and close interaction with the business. Key Responsibilities Ensure secure execution of the tax reporting process (Budget, Forecast, Actual) in a global tax environment. Develop and implement concepts for tax risk management for ContiTech. Act as a proactive point of contact for German and international group companies to identify and mitigate tax risks early. Design and deliver training programs related to tax reporting and tax risk management processes. Work independently and quality-oriented within a small global team, maintaining close communication with operational business units. Leverage technology and digital tools to enhance tax reporting accuracy and risk management efficiency. Drive automation initiatives for tax processes and reporting workflows using SAP and Business Intelligence tools. Collaborate with IT teams to integrate tax compliance requirements into ERP systems and reporting platforms. Completed degree in business administration or economics. Initial professional experience in an internationally operating industry or accounting firm; tax focus desirable. Solid knowledge of accounting standards (IFRS, local GAAP, tax balance sheet). High affinity for IT processes; strong MS Office skills; experience with SAP and tax reporting tools is highly desirable. Awareness of tax-related issues and their impact on globally operating companies. Initial experience with internal control or risk management systems/tools is an advantage. Interest in digitalization and ability to work with data analytics tools for tax risk monitoring. Fluency in English and German (written and spoken) Strong communication skills, team orientation, and intercultural competence. Applications from severely handicapped people are welcome.
